title: That Single Step Toward an Unseen Future

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Noooooooo!
This can't be real!? The shop is closing down!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Seeking the Pearl shrieking
in front of a bento shop.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Is this a nightmare?
To think this bento shop is closing down...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is a traditional flavor beloved for years, you know!?
Losing this bento is a national loss for Japan! Please don't say you're quitting, Master!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Pearl-chan...
I'd keep going if I could, but... I've hit my limit.

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Relying only on regulars means throwing away tons of unsold food every day.
It breaks my heart... I think it's time to call it quits.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The owner's shoulders slumped heavily as he spoke.
His frustration and regret were palpable.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...It's far too early to give up. Having few customers simply means
there are still so many people who haven't experienced this delicious taste, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We must spread the word! Share the charm of these brilliant bento!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Leave this to me!
I promise you, I will revive this shop!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to introduce him. He's a sales strategy advisor acquainted with my father.
When I mentioned the bento shop, he gladly offered his assistance with an eager 'By all means!'

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's roll out a long-term business plan right away.
First target: 'Aim for nationwide expansion'!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: N-Nationwide...!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Expanding the target demographic to increase sales is standard strategy!
Simple is best!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And once brand recognition grows, your bento will become a household brand!
Taking it beyond Japan to sell to the world won't just be a dream!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come, the world is waiting for your bento!
Let us move on to the next phase!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm... But barely anyone visits every day.
Aiming for the world sounds a bit impossible, don't you think...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Haaai, Pearl! You're looking a little down, aren't you?
Could it be you're out of energy on an empty stomach?!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"You bet! I'm completely starving!
I can't go to my workout like this~!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Hahaha! Then for you, we have our special Makunouchi Bento!
With its perfectly balanced nutrition, you'll double your workout gains!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl was filming a promotional video for the bento shop.
Her concept seemed to be an 'irresistibly catchy' infomercial style.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is adding multilingual subtitles, and it's a wrap.
We'll put it online and charm the whole world! Let's make full use of social media, too!"

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"The internet...? W-Will we get flamed or something?
I hear social media can be pretty scary... What if people attack us...?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"As long as we properly convey the charm of your bento, there won't be any backlash!
Instead, you should be planning for when the orders come flooding in♪"

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Even though we have leftovers every single day?
There's no way we could gain a following..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The shop owner seemed disheartened.
He just couldn't keep up with Seeking the Pearl's high-octane, aggressive style.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They clearly had different visions in mind.
Even so, deep down, the owner must genuinely want to revitalize his shop.
choice_data_list: I can't just leave them talking past each other...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During a break once filming wrapped up for a bit—
I asked Seeking the Pearl once more about her feelings toward the bento.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Let me think... 'Love'? ...No, that's not quite it.
If I had to describe that bento—it's like a spiritual hometown."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"With just one bite, it spreads across your palate.
A quintessential Japanese landscape I've never even seen before. Hehe, it's magical."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure the Master's gentle heart shines right through his cooking.
A taste of home that heals you through the most stressful days..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"You must try it at least once. Especially the chikuzenni!
Those bamboo shoots, crisp yet simmered with rich flavor to their very core, are true works of art!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The Master's bento is a jewelry box packed with an artisan's soul and craft!
It will undeniably move people all across the globe... That is what I believe!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl's passion for the bento ran far deeper than I'd imagined.
It seemed that fiery devotion was the driving force behind her grand scheme.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If what she said was true, it could certainly succeed worldwide.
However, the shop owner himself had lost all confidence...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, I needed to help him find the courage to take that first step.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. What's going on here?
I'm rather busy with the Bento Worldwide Plan, you know..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh? A food truck?
With so many Tracen Academy students lined up... Wait, that shop name is...?!"

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Pearl! And Trainer!
As you can see, business is booming!"

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"A food truck was brilliant! 
Since Tracen Academy is right nearby, so many students come by!"
choice_data_list: That's because your food was delicious from the start.

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... I was hanging my head for so long, I failed to see it.
All those customers who are genuinely happy to buy my bento."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Master... I had no idea you were that heartbroken..."

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"But seeing my customers face-to-face today gave me my confidence back.
Just like you said, Pearl, from now on I'm going to share my bento far and wide!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "!! ...Fufu. So that's how it is."

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, let's do this! Our next stop is the world stage!
...Haha, just kidding!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"What a marvelous dream... Let's make that dream a reality!
I'll help you all the way!!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, everyone! First come, first served!
You wouldn't want to miss out on an exquisite bento destined for global fame, would you?!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Take just one bite and you'll be utterly captivated!
Mmm~~! Aaa-mazing!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks in part to Seeking the Pearl's promotion, every last bento sold out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: *(Grumble...)*

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I must admit, that really worked up an appetite!
...Oh no, I got so caught up in selling that I forgot to save one for myself!"
choice_data_list: I figured you might, so I bought two!
I figured that would happen, so I bought two!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"That's my Trainer!
Come on, let's eat over on that bench! Fufufu!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bento I shared with Seeking the Pearl had a comforting flavor—
one that warmed the heart and brought back fond memories of home.
